findings.title: Native markers accept removal of a nondefault anchor
findings.reproduction: Mount a native UI Marker without children with anchor=top, then rerender with anchor omitted. The expected creation-change error is absent; rendering retains initial.anchor=top.
findings.cause: The comparison uses the initial effective anchor as the omission default, including an explicitly supplied nondefault value.
findings.correction: Freeze the content-dependent default independently of the explicit anchor, as web UI already does. Compare props.anchor against that default, then retain the initial effective creation value.
findings.evidence: A temporary test using the existing native UI fixture expected the remount error. It failed against both source and compiled modules because rerender resolved successfully.
findings.requiredRegression: Check top-to-omission rejection with and without custom content, both directions of equivalent-default updates, and default stability after children change.

findings.title: Custom adapters lose shared UI creation validation
findings.reproduction: Supply a custom Adapter whose Marker forwards to its implementation without its own creation guard. Rerender shared Marker from anchor=top to anchor=bottom. The shared facade no longer throws.
findings.cause: Creation guards were removed from every facade UI component and added only to built-in implementations. The exported Adapter interface and portable creation-input contracts did not change.
findings.correction: Retain facade enforcement of portable creation invariants for existing adapters, accepting equivalent defaults. Keep backend-specific option checks and differing defaults with their adapters.
findings.evidence: A temporary custom-adapter component test expected the remount error. It failed against source and compiled modules because rerender did not throw. The parent facade/ui.tsx enforced this explicit anchor change.
findings.requiredRegression: Use a custom Adapter through MapSetup and shared UI, without internal native presentation contexts. Check genuine creation changes and equivalent-default updates.

architectureAssessment.judgment: Separating native presentation and camera observations improves ownership and limits context updates. Moving click orchestration into a hook mostly relocates the same operation. The checkpoint does not establish broad code consolidation.
architectureAssessment.supportingMeasurement: The parent map.tsx and map-context.tsx total 473 lines. Those files plus the new interaction hook and native presentation module total 594 lines. Line count supports the ownership review but is not an acceptance target.
architectureAssessment.retain: Strict web re-querying, source attachment guards, native source registries, feature-state ordering, capture deadlines, active callback guards and portal ancestry each serve demonstrated public behavior or wrapper differences.
architectureAssessment.avoid: A universal native map-ref or lifecycle framework would obscure different readiness, query and feature-state APIs. Remove identical delegates and duplicate snapshots before attempting deeper native sharing.

compiler.evidence: Component-location compiler assertions passed. Direct emitted-body inspection found compiler memo-cache calls in all five targets. Rebuilt modules match the frozen archive.
compiler.runtime: react/compiler-runtime; library-only pre-transform; no consumer compiler configuration or extra runtime package
compiler.skipInterpretation: Diagnostics concern ref-dependent ownership or unsupported compiler syntax. Seventeen diagnostics do not mean seventeen distinct skipped functions. Map attachment, interactions, native maps/markers/UI, image registration and geolocation still include skipped code; retain their semantic stabilization.
compiler.testResolution: Web test imports from ../src resolve to dist, including internal contexts; native mapping precedes the extensionless source mapping. The two new failing probes also reproduce against compiled modules.
compiler.coverageLimit: Compiled web tests include *.web.test.tsx, excluding pure *.test.ts unit tests and example-map tests. Native tests use wrapper/host mocks and establish no native rendering behavior.
